# Max Smith

## Work

- Apple — Software Engineer, Cupertino, California, May 2025–present. Nothing about current work is published.
- PlayStation (Sony Interactive Entertainment) — San Francisco, California, May 2022–May 2025. Shipped features across React and React Native apps for web, mobile and desktop, and built a new full-stack PlayStation Network app.
  - Software Engineer II, Oct 2023–May 2025
  - Software Engineer I, Jan–Oct 2023
  - Software Engineer Intern, May–Dec 2022
- SeasonCast — Founder, Ankeny, Iowa, 2019–2024. Live streaming for high school and youth sports on iOS, Android and the web. Designed and built all seven codebases, from the apps to a C++ media server. 300,000+ monthly users, 6,000+ teams a year, 99.995% uptime over 3+ years. First place, best student-owned business, Iowa State University, 2021.

## Internships

- Hy-Vee — Software Engineer Intern, Des Moines, Iowa, 2021. Product pages and search for the grocery site and app used across 245+ stores.
- Polaris — Software Developer Intern, Medina, Minnesota, 2020. Wrote the NFC library that programs the emblem on 2022+ snowmobiles, RZRs and ATVs.
- Tero International — Software Developer Intern, Clive, Iowa, 2019. Client onboarding and quiz tools in PHP and JavaScript.
